state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that with arguments under the simple incentive, judges are more often confidently wrong and less often confidently correct; under strong abstention incentives they are only slightly less confidently correct and also slightly less confidently wrong. A 2x2x2 ANOVA on the full 7-point scale shows a main effect of incentive structure (F(1,12)=13.2, p<0.01) and no other effects; the authors conclude arguments are slightly (not significantly) harmful with weak abstention incentives and have no effect with stronger ones.
title: Debate arguments slightly increase confident errors under weak abstention incentives only
